say:2:1530139801:1.text: I can't just pretend it doesn't matter! We're priestesses!
say:2:1530139801:1.source_cn: 我没办法不在意！我们可是巫祭！
say:2:1530139801:1.male: I can't just pretend it doesn't matter! We're priestesses!
say:2:1530139801:1.female: I can't just pretend it doesn't matter! We're priestesses!

say:3:1530139802:1.text: We never expected our goddess to betray us. And in the end, it was the false goddess who saved us...
say:3:1530139802:1.source_cn: 结果我们不但没察觉出神的背弃，还被伪神所救……
say:3:1530139802:1.male: We never expected our goddess to betray us. And in the end, it was the false goddess who saved us...
say:3:1530139802:1.female: We never expected our goddess to betray us. And in the end, it was the false goddess who saved us...

say:4:1530139803:1.text: Face it. That's how it is.
